# WorkingAbroad

> > WorkingAbroad connects volunteers with meaningful conservation and community projects worldwide, specializing in wildlife and elephant conservation programs.

Based in Brighton, United Kingdom, WorkingAbroad is led by team members including Victoria McNeil (Vicky) and Dave, offering volunteer abroad opportunities with a focus on animal rescue and conservation projects, particularly in India.

## Key Topics

- Elephant conservation
- Wildlife volunteering
- India volunteer programs
- Animal rescue projects
- Volunteer abroad opportunities
- Elephant Volunteer Project
- Conservation volunteering
- International volunteering
- Wildlife protection
- Community development projects
- Sustainable tourism
- Volunteer placement services

## Volunteer Destinations

- [India Volunteer Programs](https://www.workingabroad.com/?country=in): Volunteer opportunities in India including the Elephant Volunteer Project and wildlife conservation programs

## Support & Contact

- [Contact Us](https://www.workingabroad.com/contact/): Get in touch with the WorkingAbroad team in Brighton for volunteer abroad inquiries, press enquiries, and customer support
